text: T24: low-pressure compressor outlet total temperature. Monitors the LPC and reflects compression state.
T30: high-pressure compressor outlet total temperature. Monitors the HPC outlet thermal state.
T50: low-pressure turbine outlet total temperature. Monitors the LPT exhaust thermal state.
P30: high-pressure compressor outlet total pressure. Monitors HPC compression performance.
Nf: physical fan rotational speed. Associated with the low-pressure shaft and fan rotor.
Nc: physical core rotational speed. Associated with the high-pressure core rotor.
Ps30: high-pressure compressor outlet static pressure. Describes HPC outlet pressure state.
Phi: fuel-flow to Ps30 ratio. Relates combustor fuel scheduling to compressor outlet pressure.
NRf: corrected fan speed. Describes fan rotor speed adjusted for operating conditions.
NRc: corrected core speed. Describes core rotor speed adjusted for operating conditions.
BPR: bypass ratio. Describes flow division between bypass duct and engine core.
htBleed: bleed enthalpy associated with high-pressure compressor bleed flow.
W31: high-pressure turbine coolant bleed flow. Associated with HPT thermal management.
W32: low-pressure turbine coolant bleed flow. Associated with LPT thermal management.
